branch.changed_variables_allowed: stress grid and reporting columns only

branch.comparison_baseline: Stage334 failure memory; run335B guard inputs; no-trade/random/shuffle/adjacent controls
branch.control_variables: ["fixed train/validation/OOS boundary until WFO contract is written", "fixed threshold policy until explicitly predeclared", "fixed lot/risk logic during diagnostic scoring", "Tier A separate, Tier B separate, and Tier A+B combined reporting", "no runtime authority without MT5 tester report and telemetry"]
branch.failure_criteria: branch only improves through forbidden tuning, direct filters, or subject swap
branch.hypothesis: cost_stress can guide a timestamp-safe research branch without direct forward-pocket fitting.
branch.invalid_conditions: Any design that changes lot, stop, target, or threshold after seeing cost failure.
branch.sample_scope: US100 M5 research branch design; post-2026-04-14 forward evidence remains research-only
branch.stop_conditions: Stop or downgrade if any forbidden variable is required to improve the result.
branch.success_criteria: future materialization can test the branch without forbidden tuning or direct pocket filtering

evidence_requirements.proves: all source files hashed and row-counted
no future data enters feature or label construction
Tier A separate, Tier B separate, and Tier A+B combined rows exist
shuffle/adjacent/state-neutral control is evaluated or explicitly blocked
threshold, lot, direct pocket filtering, and subject swap remain forbidden
MT5 tester output and telemetry required before runtime claim
candidate/forward/runtime/goal claims remain not_claimed unless evidence exists

fixed_control_locks.effect: no ONNX or model file is created
future branch must declare feature order before scoring
no random shuffle or pocket-specific split
all later KPI rows must preserve paired tier views or record missing_required

fixed_control_locks.effect: compile-only or Python-only parity cannot become authority
